audit_method: Each candidate was evaluated for scientific quality, spatial/temporal resolution, coverage, latency, historical depth, license, API/access method, reliability, documentation, uncertainty and relevance to wildfire prevention/validation. Statuses: integrated | candidate | rejected (with reason). Nothing is claimed as used unless it is integrated in the live pipeline.

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (via Element84 Earth Search STAC)
sources.purpose: Vegetation condition, NDVI/NDMI/NDWI, fuel-moisture estimation
sources.license: Copernicus free and open data policy
sources.limitations: Optical sensor — unusable under persistent cloud cover

sources.name: Open-Meteo forecast API
sources.purpose: Current + forecast weather, daily fire-weather series, soil moisture
sources.limitations: Numerical model output, not station observations
sources.integrated_in: analysis (weather, FWI inputs), risk grid, snapshot

sources.name: ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis (via Open-Meteo archive)
sources.purpose: Historical daily weather for fire-danger history, change detection, validation features
sources.limitations: Archive lag; daily aggregates approximate noon-standard FWI inputs

sources.name: EU-DEM 25 m (Copernicus/EEA) + SRTM 90 m (NASA) via OpenTopoData
sources.provider: EEA Copernicus / NASA, served by OpenTopoData
sources.purpose: Elevation, slope, aspect
sources.license: EU-DEM: EEA/Copernicus terms; SRTM: NASA open
sources.limitations: Static snapshot; slope is a derived approximation at grid scale

sources.name: ESA WorldCover v200
sources.purpose: Land-cover classification → burnability and fuel-model mapping
sources.limitations: Fuel-model assignment is a screening approximation

sources.name: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS S-NPP NRT, MODIS NRT)
sources.purpose: Active-fire detections (375 m / 1 km), historical fire labels for validation
sources.access: Free MAP_KEY (registration) — FIRMS_MAP_KEY env var; documented in docs/VALIDATION.md
sources.limitations: Hotspots, not perimeters; cloud/overpass gaps; NRT archive window is short
sources.hydrashield_use: integrated (activates with key; currently UNAVAILABLE — no key configured)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via ohsome API; Overpass fallback)
sources.purpose: Exposure: mapped buildings, critical facilities, roads, water features, WUI signal
sources.limitations: Completeness varies by region; counts are mapped features, not ground truth

sources.name: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoding)
sources.purpose: Free-text location → coordinates
sources.access: Free, no key (1 req/s policy respected via cache)
sources.limitations: Place-name ambiguity; rate limits

sources.name: EFFIS / GWIS (Copernicus EMS, JRC)
sources.purpose: European fire-danger maps, burned-area perimeters, fire news
sources.access: Public WMS is VIEW-ONLY (GetFeatureInfo disabled on danger layers — probed 2026-08-16); data download requires JRC data-portal registration
sources.limitations: No open point-data API found; view service only
sources.hydrashield_use: candidate (reference comparison + burned-area perimeters once a real access path exists)

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
sources.purpose: Direct Sentinel-1/2/3 product access (SAR moisture, SLSTR LST)
sources.limitations: Credential setup + quota management required
sources.hydrashield_use: candidate (would enable Sentinel-1 SAR gap-filling and Sentinel-3 LST)

sources.name: Sentinel-1 SAR
sources.purpose: All-weather radar — potential soil-moisture/backscatter gap-filling under cloud
sources.limitations: SAR→moisture retrieval needs careful calibration; not yet scientifically justified in the score

sources.name: Sentinel-3 SLSTR
sources.purpose: Land surface temperature, active-fire radiative power context
sources.limitations: Coarse vs Sentinel-2; value for the screening score unproven

sources.name: Sentinel-5P
sources.purpose: Atmospheric composition (aerosols, NO2)
sources.limitations: No defined purpose in the current fire-danger model
sources.hydrashield_use: rejected for now (no defined scientific purpose in the risk model)

sources.name: CLMS Global Burnt Area (300 m, daily)
sources.purpose: Mapped burned areas — validation labels and post-fire recovery tracking
sources.limitations: Credential requirement; 300 m minimum mapping unit

sources.name: MODIS MCD64A1 burned area
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC / University of Maryland
sources.purpose: Monthly mapped burned area at 500 m — validation labels
sources.limitations: Monthly granularity; coarse for small fires

sources.name: Global Forest Watch fire layers
sources.purpose: Fire alerts visualization
sources.limitations: Largely duplicates NASA FIRMS (same VIIRS source)

sources.name: FY-3 / FY-4 satellites (CMA NSMC)
sources.purpose: Meteorological/EO observations
sources.access: Portal registration + approval; programmatic API availability unclear; documentation primarily in Chinese
sources.license: Research use with registration (verify per dataset)
sources.limitations: Access barrier; license verification needed; no added value over integrated sources for current European pilot areas
sources.hydrashield_use: rejected for now (access/license barriers; no gap it uniquely fills)

sources.name: National Tibetan Plateau Data Center (TPDC)
sources.purpose: Regional Earth-system datasets
sources.limitations: Regional coverage does not match current monitored areas

sources.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30/GLO-90 (AWS open data)
sources.purpose: Global 30/90 m DEM — potential upgrade of non-European terrain
sources.access: Public AWS open-data bucket, no credentials
sources.limitations: Would replace only the SRTM fallback path; EU-DEM already covers Europe at 25 m

sources.name: Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS river discharge)
sources.provider: Open-Meteo (data: Copernicus EMS / EC JRC GloFAS)
sources.purpose: Daily river discharge (current nowcast + historical series) for flood analysis
sources.limitations: Hydrological model output, not gauge observations; no discharge for points far from modelled rivers

sources.name: Open-Meteo Marine API (ECMWF WAM ocean waves)
sources.purpose: Daily wave-height/period maxima (nowcast + short forecast) for coastal exposure
sources.limitations: Wave-model output; coastal bathymetry and surf zone not resolved; no data over land

sources.name: ERA5-Land soil moisture 0–7 cm (via Open-Meteo archive)
sources.purpose: Daily soil-moisture series for drought anomaly analysis
sources.limitations: Modelled soil moisture, not in-situ sensors; not exposed over water bodies
